npcs.name: Mirela Stonewright
npcs.idle: Grimspound stands because we keep our oaths. Even the ones we made to giants.

npcs.name: Brother Alun
npcs.idle: Fire. Fire and a voice in it. Leave me be.

npcs.name: Quarry-Mother Hedda
npcs.idle: Seventy years I've kept the oath with the giants. Seventy years they kept it back. Now the dragon sings and they've forgotten every word.

quests.title: The Quarry Oath
quests.offer:
Grimspound lives because of an oath. Our grandfathers cut stone from the giants' hills, and in return gave the giants a share of every stone cut, and never touched the standing stones in the east.

Someone has broken it. The heartstone is gone from the eastern circle, and the stonecallers are gathering. Before they come for Grimspound - will you [find the thief]? I think I know where to start. I'm afraid I know.
quests.summary: Someone stole the heartstone from the granite giants' standing stones, breaking the oath that keeps Grimspound safe.

steps.goal: Search the giants' building stores in the west
steps.text: A Grimspound chisel, dropped in the dirt where the heartstone was dragged. Its haft is marked with a J. Mirela's brother is the only J in the quarry.

steps.goal: Find Jory Stonewright in the brigands' camp
steps.say:
Mirela sent you. Course she did.

I sold it. All right? The brigands' captain paid me more silver than Grimspound's seen in ten years. He says once the giants flatten the town, the silver under it is his. I thought he was joking. He wasn't joking. He's got the [heartstone] in his tent.

steps.goal: Fight through the brigands' camp
Take back the heartstone from the brigand captain
steps.text: Harrow Vane goes down with silver spilling from his purse. In his tent, under a blanket, the heartstone glows like a coal.

stages.name: Harrow Vane, Brigand-Captain
stages.announce: A lean man in good boots steps out of the biggest tent. 'Grimspound's stone? It's mine. Bought and paid.'

steps.goal: Return the heartstone to the eastern circle
steps.text: The heartstone settles into its socket with a sound like a great breath. The stonecallers lower their arms, and turn, and go back into the hills.

stages.name: Keep Mirela alive while she sets the heartstone
stages.objective: Keep Mirela alive while she sets the heartstone
stages.announce: Mirela is waiting at the circle. 'Quickly - they're coming. Hold them while I set it.' Over the ridge: giants.
stages.thanks: It's set. It's set. Oh, gods, my hands.

stages.name: Stonecaller Oruk
stages.announce: A giant with a voice like a landslide: 'OATH-BREAKERS. THE STONE COMES HOME, AND SO DO YOU.'

steps.goal: Talk to Mirela at the circle
steps.say:
It's done. And Jory's waiting by the road. He knows what he did.

The giants have their own way with oath-breakers: they would take him into the hills and he would not come back. Grimspound's way is exile. I can't choose. He's my brother. You choose - give him to [the giants], or to [Grimspound].

options.say: ...Yes. It was their stone. It's their right. I'll tell him myself. That much I owe him.
Exile. He'll go west, to the coast, and never come back. It's still more mercy than he showed us. Thank you.

giants.text: The quarry wanted you to have this. And I - I want you to have his chisel. I can't look at it.

quests.title: The Dragon's Tithe
quests.offer:
This is no task for one, so find friends - GROUP work.

My order sent three slayers to study Golestandt's lair. One came back - Brother Alun, there, who will not stop shaking. One is dead. And Sir Wystan, Alun says, was alive under the rubble when Alun ran.

The giants on that slope serve the dragon - they bring it a tithe of everything that lives. Will you [go after Wystan]? Ask [Alun] what he saw, if you can bear it.

topics.Alun: Brother Alun. Over there, by the wall. Be gentle.

quests.summary: GROUP. A dragonslayer was left alive under the rubble of Golestandt's lair; the giants that serve the dragon stand between.

steps.goal: Ask Brother Alun what happened
steps.say: We were careful. We were so careful. The dragon was asleep. And then the giants came - they serve it, they bring it the dead, a [tithe] - and the rubble came down on Wystan and I ran. I RAN.

steps.goal: Go to the dragon's road in the south
steps.text: The giants watch this road. Cairns line it - each with something that once lived laid on top.

steps.goal: Kill the giants who watch the dragon's road
Search the smouldering rubble below the lair

clue.name: a scorched shield with a white hart

steps.text: Sir Wystan's shield. Under it, a gap in the rubble - and a voice, hoarse with smoke: 'Took your time.'

steps.goal: Dig Sir Wystan out of the rubble
steps.text: The last stone comes away. Sir Wystan crawls out, burnt and grinning.

stages.name: Keep Sir Wystan alive while he is dug out
stages.objective: Keep Sir Wystan alive while he is dug out
stages.announce: The rubble shifts under your hands - and the stonelords come down the slope to collect their tithe.
stages.thanks: Ha! Ha. Ow. Bryn sent you? Bryn would.

stages.name: Stonelord Gauth, Tithe-Taker
stages.announce: A huge giant with a basket on its back of bones. 'THE SLAYER IS THE DRAGON'S. ALL WHO FALL HERE ARE THE DRAGON'S.'

steps.goal: Talk to Sir Wystan
steps.say:
I saw it. Golestandt. Woke while the rocks were falling, looked right at me. Then looked away, and went back to sleep. Like I was a fly.

I cut this off it - a scale - before the rubble. Bryn will want it. With this she'll have the order's council behind her, and they'll march on the lair by spring.

Or you tell her I said [leave it sleeping]. Because it let us go, and I don't think it will twice. Or give her [the scale]. Your choice. I'm too tired.

options.say: Then take it, and tell her I'll be at the front of the line. Gods help us.
Thank you. Tell her it was my word, not yours. She'll hate it less.

steps.goal: Return to Bryn Asquith
steps.say:
A scale. A real scale. The council will have to listen now.

And Wystan alive - Alun stopped shaking when he heard. Take what you like from the armoury. Come spring, we'll need everyone.

steps.goal: Return to Bryn Asquith
steps.say:
'Leave it sleeping.' From Wystan, of all men.

...He's right, I suppose. He usually isn't. Take what you like. And thank you for bringing him home.

quests.title: The Stonecrush
quests.offer:
The Stonecrush - the giants' diggers, broad as doors - came up the west valley a month ago, and they haven't stopped digging since. Every day closer to Grimspound.

Will you [stop the digging]?
quests.summary: The Stonecrush, the giants' diggers, are digging up Dartmoor's west valley toward Grimspound.

steps.goal: Kill the Stonecrush excavators about 400 m south of Bryn Asquith
Tell Bryn Asquith
steps.say: Stopped. For today. Tomorrow there'll be more - they don't dig for themselves.

quests.title: The Dragon's Road
quests.offer:
They don't dig for themselves. They dig in a line - north, straight as an arrow, from the dragon's lair toward the moor's edge. A road.

Go up to the dig-head and [see where it goes]. Then tell me I'm wrong.
quests.summary: The Stonecrush are digging a straight road north from Golestandt's lair.

steps.goal: Fight through the Stonecrush rockgrinders about 270 m south of Bryn Asquith
Search the dig-head
steps.text: A line of white stakes running north, all the way to the edge of the moor - and beyond, toward Cornwall, and Avalon, and Salisbury. Golestandt is building his giants a road to the Giants' Dance.

steps.goal: Tell Bryn Asquith
steps.say: To the Dance. To Salisbury. The giants are marching north on a dragon's road. I wish I'd been wrong.

quests.title: Kez of the Demolishers
quests.offer:
The Stonecrush have a boss - Kez, down in the south-west digs, with his demolishers. Kill Kez and the digging stops for a season.

It's a group's fight. Will you [go for Kez]?
quests.summary: Kez leads the Stonecrush demolishers in Dartmoor's south-west digs.

steps.goal: Bring down Kez about 1.0 km south of Bryn Asquith
Tell Bryn Asquith
steps.say: Kez is down. The dig's quiet. A season, maybe two. Long enough for the Watch to march.

quests.title: The Ponies of the Moor
quests.offer:
The moor ponies were here before Grimspound, before the giants, before anything. The herdsmen are driving them off the north moor - into the lake, some of them - to make room for whatever's coming down the dragon's road.

Will you [stop the herdsmen]?
quests.summary: Granite giant herdsmen are driving the wild ponies off Dartmoor's north moor.

steps.goal: Stop the granite giant herdsmen about 860 m east of Mirela Stonewright
Tell Mirela Stonewright
steps.say: The ponies will come back. They always do. It's the giants I'm not sure of.

quests.title: Tegbuk
quests.offer:
Tegbuk. The herd-chief. He swore the quarry oath with my grandfather - I saw him do it when I was a girl. He's the one sending the herdsmen. He's forgotten every word.

It needs a group. Will you [remind him]?
quests.summary: Tegbuk, the giants' herd-chief, who swore the quarry oath with Grimspound, now drives the ponies off the moor.

steps.goal: Bring down Tegbuk about 750 m east of Mirela Stonewright
Tell Mirela Stonewright
steps.say: He looked at you, at the end? They say oath-breakers remember, at the end. I hope he did.

quests.title: The Stonecallers
quests.offer:
The stonecallers sing to the stones in their ring in the middle valleys. They used to sing the stones awake for the quarry. Now they sing the dragon's song, and the stones listen.

Will you [break the singing]?
quests.summary: The granite giant stonecallers sing Golestandt's song in their ring in Dartmoor's middle valleys.

steps.goal: Silence the stonecallers about 810 m south-east of Quarry-Mother Hedda
Tell Quarry-Mother Hedda
steps.say: Quiet. For an hour. Do you know what they were singing? I do. I wish I didn't.

quests.title: The Speaking-Stone
quests.offer:
In the middle of the ring is the speaking-stone - the giants' oldest. When they swore the quarry oath, they swore it on that stone. If anything still remembers the oath, it does.

Will you [listen to the stone]? Put your hand on it. Don't be afraid of what it says.
quests.summary: The giants' speaking-stone stands at the heart of the stonecallers' ring.

steps.goal: Put your hand on the speaking-stone

clue.name: a tall grey stone, warm to the touch

steps.text: The stone speaks - in a voice like a furnace door opening: 'GOGMAGOG FELL. HIS BONES STIR UNDER THE PLAIN. THE THRONE IS WARM. A NEW KING SITS IT WHEN THE DRAGON CALLS: CORMORAN OF THE MOUNT.' Then, very small, under it, an old giant's voice: 'the oath, the oath, remember the oath'.

steps.goal: Tell Quarry-Mother Hedda
steps.say:
Cormoran. Cormoran of the Mount, the biggest of them, who ate Cornwall's cattle when my grandmother was a girl. And under it - the oath, still. Something still remembers.

That's the dragon's plan, then. He doesn't want a road. He wants a giant king on Gogmagog's throne, and every giant in Albion behind him.

quests.title: The Stone-Herald
quests.offer:
The voice in the stone - it comes from the Stone-Herald, the giant who speaks for the dragon. He stands in the ring and sings Golestandt's words into every stone on the moor.

Kill the voice and the moor goes quiet. Bring a group. Will you [silence the Herald]?
quests.summary: The Stone-Herald, the giant who speaks for Golestandt, sings the dragon's words into Dartmoor's stones from the stonecallers' ring.

steps.goal: Silence the Stone-Herald about 810 m south-east of Quarry-Mother Hedda
Tell Quarry-Mother Hedda
steps.say:
Quiet. The whole moor, quiet. I can hear the ponies.

Go and see Bryn. The Watch has a road to march down now.

quests.title: The Outlookers
quests.offer:
The outlookers watch the south road - the road to the lair and the throne. Nothing gets down it without them knowing, and the pounders come when they shout.

Will you [blind the road]?
quests.summary: Granite giant outlookers watch the south road to Golestandt's lair and Gogmagog's throne.

steps.goal: Kill the granite giant outlookers about 1.1 km south-east of Bryn Asquith
Tell Bryn Asquith
steps.say: Blind. For now. The Watch can use that.

quests.title: The Knockers
quests.offer:
Every miner knows: the knockers knock where the treasure is. Ours knock where the dragon sleeps now - all day, all night, under the south road. They're waking him, or he's waking them.

Will you [quiet the knocking]?
quests.summary: The granite knockers knock under Dartmoor's south road, where Golestandt sleeps.

steps.goal: Quiet the granite knockers about 1.3 km south-east of Mirela Stonewright
Tell Mirela Stonewright
steps.say: Quiet. You can hear something else now, under the road. Breathing.

quests.title: Gorm Throne-Warden
quests.offer:
Gorm Throne-Warden keeps Gogmagog's throne in the south-east - keeps it warm, the stonecallers say, for the king who's coming. While Gorm stands, nothing gets near it.

You'll want a group - two, if you can. Will you [face Gorm]?
quests.summary: Gorm Throne-Warden keeps Gogmagog's empty throne in Dartmoor's south-east, waiting for a king.

steps.goal: Bring down Gorm Throne-Warden about 1.6 km south-east of Bryn Asquith
Tell Bryn Asquith
steps.say: Gorm's down. The throne's open. Go and look at it - I want to know what you see.

quests.title: The Giants' Throne
quests.offer: Gorm's gone, and Gogmagog's throne is open. Will you [look at the throne]? Carefully. Then come back and tell me what a giant king's throne looks like with no one on it.
quests.summary: Gogmagog's throne stands empty in Dartmoor's south-east, with Gorm Throne-Warden gone.

steps.goal: Go to the Giants' Throne in the south-east
steps.text: A seat of raw granite the height of three men - empty, for now. Beside it the stonelords are cutting a crown out of the living rock, and one of them is the biggest giant you have ever seen: Cormoran, the giant of the Mount, trying it on for size. Far to the west, under the south road, something breathes out, pleased.

steps.goal: Tell Bryn Asquith what you saw
steps.say:
Cormoran. With a crown. On Gogmagog's throne.

The dragon's making him a king - the first giant king of Albion since Gogmagog - and every giant on the moor will follow. Sir Constantine has to march, now, before the crown is finished.

Will you go with the [Watch], under Constantine's banner? Or for [Grimspound] - Hedda says the oath-stone remembers, and if Gogmagog is broken, the giants might remember too.

options.say: Then you're the Dragon-Watch's. Constantine's at the town gate. Give him the word.
Then you're the oath's. Hedda will be glad. Constantine's at the town gate - give him the word anyway. The oath needs the Watch.

watch.text: From the Dragon-Watch. Sir Constantine waits at Grimspound: give him the word when you're ready to march.

oath.text: From the Quarry-Oath of Grimspound. Sir Constantine waits at Grimspound: give him the word when you're ready to march.
